name: twrses-chips
description: 晶片與半導體 Chips and Semiconductors 3D 模型的原始碼與打包設定。產物寫到 assets/js/，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/chip-doping.js src/chip-transistor.js src/chip-wafer.js src/chip-litho.js src/chip-scale.js src/chip-package.js src/chip-hbm.js src/chip-island.js src/chip-heat.js src/chip-ai.js src/chip-fab.js src/chip-led.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/doping.test.mjs && node test/transistor.test.mjs && node test/wafer.test.mjs && node test/litho.test.mjs && node test/scale.test.mjs && node test/package.test.mjs && node test/hbm.test.mjs && node test/island.test.mjs && node test/heat.test.mjs && node test/ai.test.mjs && node test/fab.test.mjs && node test/led.test.mjs
